# VSMECAP

> VSMECAP is early-stage software that helps UK SMEs prepare structured sustainability reports from utility bills, based on the EFRAG VSME standard (the Voluntary Sustainability Reporting Standard for non-listed SMEs). Reports are structured for review. They are not audited, and VSMECAP is not certified or endorsed by EFRAG. VSME is voluntary and is not UK law.

"VSME" on this site means the sustainability reporting standard, not a stock ticker.

## What works today
- Upload 12 months of electricity, gas and water bills; extract kWh, m3 and meter numbers (MPAN/MPRN); review and correct the values.
- Draft the Basic module (B1-B11) energy and Scope 1 and 2 greenhouse gas figures.
- Export JSON, CSV and a watermarked draft PDF. Files are processed locally in the browser.
- A free tier is available for eligible businesses with up to 1,000 employees.

## In development (not yet available)
- Integrity hashing (SHA-256), Inline XBRL export, automated utility data links.

## Key facts
- Basic module: B1-B11. Optional Comprehensive module: C1-C9.
- Directive (EU) 2026/470 (Omnibus I) introduces a value chain cap for undertakings with up to 1,000 employees, subject to national implementation by 19 March 2027. It is EU law, so UK companies are not automatically covered.
- Commission Recommendation (EU) 2025/1710 (30 July 2025) recommends the VSME for voluntary use. It is not binding.
- UK public sector: PPN 006 applies to procurements under the Procurement Act 2023; PPN 06/21 applies to earlier ones.

- [Commission Recommendation (EU) 2025/1710](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reco/2025/1710/oj/eng)
